disposition: Retain C12, C13 and C14 as question-only review-ready candidates.
c12: Exact ordinary-map Conjecture 4.14 formulation; no correction.

c13.provenance: New proposed first-passage strengthening motivated by the stochastic model; no proof found in screened sources.
c13.normalization: Correct; drift d/2, variance (log3)^2/4 and barrier distance log(n)/2.
c13.known_results: Successive-limit CLTs in Kontorovich-Lagarias section5 and first-order/density-one transport in Inselmann do not establish this diagonal limit.
c13.asymptotic_obstructions: No defect found; deterministic lower endpoint tends to negative infinity, lattice spacing tends to zero. Finite data must not be advertised as Gaussian convergence.
c13.logical_scope: Bounded modification observation correct, including simultaneous nonexistence of passage. It illustrates information ignored, not logical independence for fixed Collatz. No equivalence or strict hardness ordering claimed.

c14: Independently read downloaded manuscript sections2,4,5,9. Conductor is an exponent; theorem5.2 remains superpolynomial. Internal exponential errors do not prove the target. Overlap hold resolved.
